scope: Private experimental controllers only; no public Auto preset.
observations: Only at buffer expansion; compare recent checkpoint density with previous and global density. Existing reservations cannot be undone.
maturity: n>=1024, consumed bytes>=4096, two stable checkpoints (ratio 0.5..2), or one stable checkpoint under copy pressure.
density_change: Drop below 0.25 or rise above 4 times previous checkpoint density; rescale future reservations, never restart parsing.
endpoint: When consumed bytes equal input length, reserve only pending token and necessary EOF; geometric floor is unnecessary there.

structural_checks.journal: Fixed 512-entry stack buffer in separate trace builds; require zero dropped decisions.
structural_checks.semantics: Compare full token fields, canonical values and diagnostics with both production fixed modes.

freeze: Freeze controller, plan and measured binaries before generating the full holdout; do not retune using held-out results.

empirical_promotion_targets.non_tiny: Inputs with production Balanced median parse time >=1 ms; report all inputs regardless.
empirical_promotion_targets.speed: Worst median time/oracle(min fixed times) <=1.5 on non-tiny inputs.
empirical_promotion_targets.memory: Worst median time/Balanced <=2 and peak/oracle(min fixed peaks) <=1.5 on non-tiny inputs.
empirical_promotion_targets.meaning: Experimental acceptance targets on this machine; not latency or allocator guarantees. Public promotion is a separate decision.
